title: Pool Service Software Cost 2026: Real Prices Compared
description: How much pool service software costs: published prices for Skimmer, Pool Brain, Pool Office Manager, GorillaDesk and Jobber, with yearly cost by pool count.
h1: How much does pool service software cost?
body:
Short answer: published pool service software prices start around $29–$49/mo for entry plans and climb past $100/mo once you add techs or pass ~50 pools. The model matters more than the sticker: Skimmer bills per serviced location, GorillaDesk per route, Pool Brain per field tech, and Pool Office Manager per user. Every figure below is the vendor's own list price, re-checked on 2026-11-03 (Skimmer, GorillaDesk, Pool Brain, Pool Office Manager, Jobber), with Skimmer, Pool Brain and Paythepoolman checked again on 2026-11-09. Prices exclude tax, card processing and add-ons. For features and picks, see best pool service software and the pool service hub.

Yearly cost examples (published list prices)

  • Solo tech, ~40 pools: Skimmer Getting Started $588/yr ($49 × 12). GorillaDesk Basic $588/yr for 1 route. Jobber Core $348/yr billed annually ($29 × 12). Pool Brain with 1 field tech $1,380/yr ($115 × 12). Paythepoolman with 1 tech $780/yr ($65 × 12). Pool Office Manager 1 user $1,500/yr ($125 × 12).
  • Solo tech, ~80 pools on Skimmer Scaling Up: plan starts at $98/mo including 49 locations, plus $2 per additional location — about $160/mo (~$1,920/yr) by the vendor's published formula. Confirm on Skimmer's calculator before you commit. {{aff:skimmer|See Skimmer pricing}}
  • 3 field techs: Pool Brain = $50 + (3 × $65) = $245/mo ($2,940/yr). Paythepoolman = $50 + (3 × $15) = $95/mo ($1,140/yr). Pool Office Manager 3 users = $125 + (2 × $25) = $175/mo ($2,100/yr). GorillaDesk 3 Basic routes = $149/mo ($1,788/yr) per its published route table. {{aff:gorilladesk|See GorillaDesk plans}}
  • 10 users (POM example): Pool Office Manager publishes $350/mo for 10 users ($125 + 9 × $25).

Which pricing model fits your route

  • Billed by pool count: Skimmer. Cheap under ~49 pools at $49/mo; cost rises linearly after that on Scaling Up.
  • Billed by route / tech schedule: GorillaDesk. Unlimited users; Basic routing stops at 25 stops per route.
  • Billed by field tech: Pool Brain. Office seats are free inside the $50 base; each active field tech adds $65/mo.
  • Billed by tech, lower per-tech price: Paythepoolman. Same $50 base as Pool Brain, but $15/mo per tech instead of $65.
  • Billed by seat, seasonal-friendly: Pool Office Manager. Higher one-user price, but you can turn seats off in the off-season.
  • General field service, lowest published entry: Jobber Core at $29/mo annually — useful if you also do repairs or mixed trades, but pool chemistry tools are unknown on its pricing page. {{aff:jobber|See Jobber plans}}

Costs on top of the subscription

  • Card processing: Jobber lists 2.9% + 30¢ online; Pool Office Manager uses Stripe at Stripe's rates; GorillaDesk uses Stripe or Square; Skimmer, Pool Brain and Paythepoolman rates are unknown on their pricing pages (Paythepoolman offers an optional $1.50 convenience fee per card payment, paid by your customer).
  • Texting: Skimmer Getting Started lists Service Texts at $0.029/message (unlimited texts included on Scaling Up); GorillaDesk SMS is $5/mo plus credit packs; Pool Office Manager customer texting starts from $10/mo.
  • QuickBooks: Pool Office Manager QuickBooks Online sync is +$25/mo; GorillaDesk includes QBO sync on Pro; Jobber includes QBO sync from Connect.
  • Skimmer add-ons: AI Phone $99/mo, Marketing Suite $150/mo and Bookkeeping from $198/mo on every plan; CRM Integrations $49/mo and Google Calendar $25/mo on Getting Started and Scaling Up (included on Enterprise). Checked 2026-11-09.
  • Paythepoolman add-ons: Pool Junction customer app $25/mo (needed for ACH, Apple Pay and Google Pay), payroll $12/employee/mo plus a one-time sign-up fee, and text credit packs (pack prices not published).
  • Setup / migration: Pool Brain and Pool Office Manager list free setup or free data migration; GorillaDesk lists free data migration and no setup fees; others unknown.

faq: How much does pool service software cost per month?

Published entry prices checked November 3, 2026: Jobber Core $29/mo billed annually ($49 monthly), Skimmer Getting Started from $49/mo, GorillaDesk Basic $49/mo per route, Pool Brain $50 base + $65 per field tech ($115 for 1 tech), and Pool Office Manager $125/mo for the first user.
Which pool software is cheapest for a solo tech?

By published list prices, Jobber Core is $29/mo billed annually, Skimmer Getting Started and GorillaDesk Basic both start at $49/mo, and Paythepoolman is $65/mo for one tech ($50 base + $15). Jobber does not list chemical tracking on its pricing page (checked 2026-11-09).
Does pool service software charge per pool?

Skimmer does: $1 or $2 per serviced location per month depending on plan, with locations you don't service that month not billed. Pool Brain, Pool Office Manager, GorillaDesk and Jobber use tech, user, route or seat pricing instead.
How much is Pool Brain for 5 technicians?
Pool Brain's pricing page formula is $50/mo base plus $65/mo per active field tech, so 5 techs = $375/mo as shown in its example.
Are there free trials for pool service software?

Skimmer offers a promotional first month free on Scaling Up plus a 30-day refund guarantee. Pool Office Manager lists a 30-day trial (card at signup, charged on day 30 unless cancelled). GorillaDesk and Jobber list 14-day free trials with no credit card. Pool Brain offers a free trial; length not stated on its pricing page.
